findings.fixtureClock: A synthetic journal sampled the issue and deadline clock twice; a 1ms tick could make the required 5000ms window 5001ms. Fixture now derives both from one sample.
findings.additionalCI: Run 44753407506 reached all remaining shards except an old historical test's setup that expected an inline custody declaration, abandoned native workers and hit the 20-minute runner ceiling. The historical fixture now exercises the current selector, pins the closed QA hash domain and disposes the harness if setup fails. The original deadline test independently checks absence of an OAuth cookie and of a SQL effect even when the timed-out transport already closed the response body.
